📖 How to use

  1. Enter any two of the three sides: leg a, leg b, hypotenuse c.
  2. Leave the unknown side blank.
  3. Press Solve.
  4. Read the missing side, area, perimeter and both acute angles.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which sides do I enter?

Leave exactly one of the three boxes empty. The tool solves the missing side; filling all three or only one shows an error.

Why does it say the hypotenuse must be longest?

The hypotenuse must be strictly longer than either leg. If your 'c' is shorter, the inputs are checked and rejected.

How are the angles found?

With inverse tangent: the acute angles are atan(a/b) and atan(b/a), converted to degrees. The right angle is always 90°.
